findings.label: AxisScore required-key looseness
findings.detail: The security-assessment schema 'score' object marks value/calibration_id/evidence_refs as required (present, though value and calibration_id are nullable), but AxisScore supplies defaults (value=None, calibration_id=None, evidence_refs default factory). A JSON payload omitting those keys validates against the model though it would be rejected by the JSON schema. This loosens input acceptance in the permissive direction only; the semantics/value consistency validator still runs and no unsafe value is admitted. Consider Field(...) or a presence check if exact schema round-trip parity is required in a later task.
